name: Yamaha XJ750 Seca
engine: 748 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs, shaft drive
intro: A capable early-80s four. The starter clutch, carbs and anti-dive brake system need the most care.

add.title: Bleed the brakes through the anti-dive
add.instructions: Flush fluid through each caliper and out through the anti-dive units. Expect it to take patience to get all the air out.
add.reason: Air trapped in the anti-dive parts gives a soft lever.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Starter clutch
known.what: Owners say starter clutch issues are real on the Seca 750.
